lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Because the original registration is at the Divisional Secretariat. Your address confirmation is at the local office. The voter roll consolidation is at the District Secretariat.

lines.speaker: Nandadasa Mahaththaya
lines.text: Each office verifies one thing the other cannot verify. It is not slow because it is broken. It is slow because it is thorough.
He went back to stamping. You have your answer. He has given it seventeen thousand times and he gave it the same way this time.
